title: November 2025 holiday update: Improved activity customization and organization
summary: Our November 2025 holiday update includes personalized onboarding with Sparky, customized response styles, and bulk activity imports to make teaching more tailored to you.
body_markdown:
This holiday season, Sparky wants to learn more about you and give you more control over how Flint supports your teaching. Plus, a fresh new look to match where we’re headed next.


## 🌟 Sparky learns who you are, right from the start


Sparky now asks you some quick questions on your role, grade level, subjects, and what you want to do with Flint. Sparky remembers these details automatically, so you don’t have to keep repeating them every time you create a new activity or start a chat.


## 🗣️ Choose how talkative Sparky should be


You can now control how detailed Sparky’s responses are inside any activity. Use the new slider to choose the level of explanation your students need: quick hints, step-by-step breakdowns, or something in between.


## 📚 Bulk import activities in a group


Save time re-using your best work. We improved activity imports so let teachers select a workspace, choose a term, and bring over groups of activities in one click. This is great for teachers who run the same course each year or who want to reuse a full unit without manually selecting each activity.


## 🧡 We may look a little more…orange


We’ve refreshed Flint from top to bottom: a new logo, new colors, and a brand-new website. Our redesign includes more resources for teachers and students, so stay on the lookout for new tools, blogs, and more!
